name: bibliodocs-pro
description: Aplicativo desktop para elaborar e formatar trabalhos acadêmicos conforme o Manual de Normalização da UFT e as normas ABNT.
author: BiblioDocs Pro

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.puro.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.verificar: npm run typecheck && vitest run && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm audit signatures
scripts.verificar:tudo: npm run verificar && npm run build && playwright test
scripts.dist: node empacotamento/terceiros.cjs --conferir && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:pasta: node empacotamento/terceiros.cjs --conferir && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:fumaca: node empacotamento/terceiros.cjs --conferir && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win dir --x64 --publish never -c.extraMetadata.bibliodocsFumaca=true -c.directories.output=release-fumaca
